How often babies feed varies. As a very rough guide, your baby should 
feed at least eight times or more every 24 hours during the first few 
weeks. It‟s fine to feed your baby whenever they are hungry, when your 
breasts feel full or if you just want to have a cuddle. It‟s not possible to 
overfeed a breastfed baby. 
Breastfed babies generally feed more frequently than bottle-fed babies. 
Once the milk has come, new-born will typically feed 8 -12 times a day. 
This does not mean that the child is not getting enough milk each time.
